prompts.sky: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape background painting for a Korean children's fantasy jumping runner browser game called Cloud Tower. Generate one polished 1536x1024 landscape environment image, NO text, NO UI, NO characters. Scene: a breathtaking luminous sky archipelago above a vast sea of fluffy clouds, distant floating grass islands with curling waterfalls, pale turquoise sky, sunny cream clouds, turquoise and emerald greenery, a sweeping pale rainbow, little distant whimsical windmills and tiny golden-roofed fairytale towers. Style: high-end stylized 3D family platformer game environment, painterly soft shapes and richly shaded materials, vibrant blue cyan emerald gold, magical warm sunlight and soft atmospheric perspective. Composition: horizon in upper half; central and lower-middle gameplay area mostly open soft sky and clouds so a foreground runner and separate floating platforms remain readable. Rich distant islands frame far left and far right. Depth and sense of flying high above the world. Original game art. No recognizable existing IP, no words, no watermark, no playable foreground platforms baked into image.
prompts.runner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, 1536x1024, exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, 8 separate full-body poses. No grid lines or text. Original adorable childlike fantasy sky runner, chibi stylized 3D proportions with large head and short athletic limbs, chestnut tousled hair, teal aviator goggles on head, cream and teal explorer jacket, bright orange long scarf trailing LEFT, teal shorts, cream oversized sneakers with orange soles, small tan backpack. Friendly expressive determined face. Consistent SAME character, costume, rendering, size and camera in ALL frames. All faces/body mainly facing RIGHT with a slight front three-quarter view, ready to travel right across floating islands. Smooth polished shaded 3D family game art. Each sprite FULLY INSIDE its own 384x512 cell with 35px transparent margin, feet baseline near 450px in each cell, heads near 75px, centered horizontally. Row 1 left-to-right: standing ready smiling; running stride left leg forward; running stride right leg forward; low knees-bent anticipation crouch. Row 2 left-to-right: powerful upward takeoff arms trailing; airborne jump with forward knee lifted and arms spread; landing crouch knees compressed; victory pose fist raised. Clean silhouette, separate hands and limbs, no motion streaks, no platforms, no ground shadows, no background, no border, no labels. Actual transparent background for Canvas compositing, not a checkerboard painting.
prompts.islands: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game environment sprite atlas PNG, REAL transparent alpha background, 1536x1024, EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows, four separate floating platform assets. No text or grid lines. Same polished richly shaded 3D cartoon fantasy style as a sky runner game. Camera consistent slightly elevated three-quarter SIDE view, landing surfaces flat horizontal ellipses with shallow depth, front rocky sides visible. Each full asset isolated in a 768x512 cell, centered with at least 65 pixels transparent padding. Row1 left: broad oval floating grassy island with thick mint green turf, golden sandstone underside and soft cloud wisps below, tiny flowers only at edges, big clean flat landing top. Row1 right: special spring island with a luminous golden inset circle on the flat green landing surface, golden crystal underside and cloud base. Row2 left: large broad magical cloud platform with puffy dimensional cream white cloud underside and a flat luminous sky-blue landing top edged in gold. Row2 right: large grumpy storm cloud obstacle character, blue-violet and dark indigo voluminous cloud, expressive glowing cyan eyes, small golden lightning bolts hanging below, charming mischievous not scary. All four assets must fit entirely inside their own cell. No extra assets, no UI, no words, no checkerboard. Genuine transparent background for canvas compositing.
